reading.body:
Vantage VA13 is one building in the Ashburn I campus, a six-building, 52-acre facility in Sterling, Virginia. The operator publishes 206 MW of critical IT load and 1.7 million square feet across all six buildings at full buildout, with over 1 million square feet already operational. No figure specific to VA13 alone has been published, so this building's contribution to the campus total cannot be separated from available data.

At the campus-wide density of up to 300 W per square foot, the operator's stated 1.7 million square feet implies a potential IT load approaching the published 206 MW. Assuming 40 kW per rack as a common AI training density, 206 MW of IT load would correspond to roughly 5,150 racks; at higher densities typical of GPU clusters, that footprint would hold fewer, denser racks. The operator publishes no tenant list or power-per-building breakdown.

Virginia has 326 mapped data centers, 23 with published capacity figures totaling 1,375 MW. The Ashburn I campus, at 206 MW published, ranks 24th in the state by announced capacity, below the top 23 facilities with individual figures on the record. This facility sits in the Ashburn market, Northern Virginia's primary data center cluster, but remains below the threshold of published capacity that would place it among the state's ranked operators.
